queries.compiledQueryString:
select vencimento, dte, avg(-theta_dia / nullif(premio_usd, 0)) as "Theta diário / prêmio"
from arbcripto.opcoes
where tipo = 'C' and abs(delta - 0.5) < 0.08 and dte >= 1
group by vencimento, dte order by dte
